from PyQt5.uic import loadUi
from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QApplication, QMessageBox, QTableWidgetItem
from pickle import dump, load


def Ajouter():
    x = win.x.text()
    if x == "" or x.isdigit() == False or int(x) <= 0:
        QMessageBox.critical(win, "erreur", "saisir un entier >0")
    else:
        f1 = open("nombre.txt", "a")
        f1.write(x + "\n")
        f1.close()


def affichage_f1():
    win.list_f1.clear()
    f1 = open("nombre.txt", "r")
    ch = f1.readline().strip()
    while(ch != ""):
        win.list_f1.addItem(ch)
        ch = f1.readline().strip()
    f1.close()


def convb10_bb(x, b):
    ch = ""
    while x != 0:
        r = x % b
        x = x // b
        if r < 10:
            ch = str(r) + ch
        else:
            ch = chr(55 + r) + ch
    return ch


def remplir_f2():
    f1 = open("nombre.txt", "r")
    f2 = open("conversion.dat", "wb")
    ch = f1.readline()
    while (ch != ""):
        x = int(ch)
        e = {}
        e["dec"] = x
        e["bin"] = convb10_bb(x, 2)
        e["oct"] = int(convb10_bb(x, 8))
        e["hex"] = convb10_bb(x, 16)
        dump(e, f2)
        ch = f1.readline()
    f1.close()
    f2.close()


def affichage_f2():
    f2 = open("conversion.dat", "rb")
    fin_fichier = False
    i = 0
    win.table_f2.setRowCount(0)
    while not fin_fichier:
        try:
            e = load(f2)
            win.table_f2.insertRow(i)
            win.table_f2.setItem(i, 0, QTableWidgetItem(str(e["dec"])))
            win.table_f2.setItem(i, 1, QTableWidgetItem(e["bin"]))
            win.table_f2.setItem(i, 2, QTableWidgetItem(str(e["oct"])))
            win.table_f2.setItem(i, 3, QTableWidgetItem(e["hex"]))
            i = i + 1
        except:
            fin_fichier = True
    f2.close()


def cherche():
    x = win.x2.text()
    if x == "" or x.isdigit() == False or int(x) <= 0:
        QMessageBox.critical(win, "erreur", "saisir un entier >0")
    else:
        f2 = open("conversion.dat", "rb")
        fin_fichier = False
        trouve = False
        while not fin_fichier and trouve == False:
            try:
                e = load(f2)
                if e["dec"] == int(x):
                    trouve = True
                    win.msg.setText("bin:" + e["bin"] + "\n" + "oct:" +
                                    str(e["oct"]) + "\n" + "hex:" + e["hex"] + "\n")
            except:

                fin_fichier = True
        f2.close()
        if trouve == False:
            win.msg.setText("entier introuvable")


app = QApplication([])
win = loadUi("interface_conversion.ui")
win.show()
win.btn1.clicked.connect(Ajouter)
win.btn2.clicked.connect(affichage_f1)
win.btn3.clicked.connect(remplir_f2)
win.btn4.clicked.connect(affichage_f2)
win.btn5.clicked.connect(cherche)
app.exec_()
